# `csharp_indent_labels`

How goto labels are indented.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `one_less_than_current` |  |
| `flush_left` |  |
| `no_change` |  |

**Default:** `one_less_than_current`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run(bool skip)
    {
        if (skip)
            goto end;
        Console.WriteLine("working");
    end:
        Console.WriteLine("done");
    }
}
```

### `csharp_indent_labels = one_less_than_current`

```ini
csharp_indent_labels = one_less_than_current
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `csharp_indent_labels = flush_left`

```ini
csharp_indent_labels = flush_left
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run(bool skip)
    {
        if (skip)
            goto end;
        Console.WriteLine("working");
end:
        Console.WriteLine("done");
    }
}
```

### `csharp_indent_labels = no_change`

```ini
csharp_indent_labels = no_change
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run(bool skip)
    {
        if (skip)
            goto end;
        Console.WriteLine("working");
        end:
        Console.WriteLine("done");
    }
}
```
